item.title: Complete Electrode Model
item.description: The Complete Electrode Model (CEM) is the standard model for the Forward Problem of Electrical Impedance Tomography.

item.title: Electrical Impedance Tomography
item.description: Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT) recovers the conductivity \sigma inside a body \Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^d from voltage measurements taken with electrodes on its boundary \partial\Omega.

item.title: Forward Problem
item.description: The forward problem maps a conductivity \sigma and a current pattern I to the electrode voltages U = F(\sigma) I.

item.title: Tikhonov Regularization
item.description: Tikhonov regularization penalises the distance to a reference conductivity \sigma_0: R(\sigma) = \frac{\alpha}{2} \lVert \sigma - \sigma_0 \rVert_2^2 .
